combo_label: Christmas × Musical Instruments × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Paper-covered package passed round a circle of children to music
Smallest pipe in the woodwind row, cutting shrill and clean over the whole band
John whose honeyed modern carols conquered Christmas
White crystalline coating on the grass and the windows of a cold morning
Bishop's seat and a city's great church, vaults ringing with voices
Daily choral office pairing Magnificat with Nunc Dimittis as the light fails
Screwed metal collar clamping the cane blade to a mouthpiece
Black cylinder of woodwind, flared at the bell, warm and woody down low
Units the conductor counts, marked off down the page by upright lines
Chinese two-string fiddle whose bow hair runs between the strings
Antlered tundra animal, hitched up in a team of eight or nine
Short-needled conifer, the Trafalgar Square giant sent over each year by Oslo
